Task Name: US-001: Implement OAuth2.0 / OIDC Social Login Integration
Description:
As a user, I want to log in using Google, Apple, and GitHub SSO so that registration is frictionless.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Support Google, Apple, and GitHub OAuth 2.0 endpoints.
2. Auto-map user profile metadata (email, full name, avatar).
3. Handle OAuth failure gracefully with readable UI error messages.

Task Name: US-002: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) via TOTP / Authenticator App
Description:
As a security-conscious user, I want to enable MFA via Google Authenticator or Authy so that my account is protected against unauthorized access.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Generate QR Code containing base32 secret.
2. Provide 10 single-use backup recovery codes.
3. Enforce 6-digit TOTP validation during login upon activation.

Task Name: US-003: JWT Token Refresh & Revocation Architecture
Description:
As a backend system, I need access and refresh token mechanisms with redis token blacklisting so that sessions are secure.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Access tokens expire in 15 minutes.
2. Refresh token rotation implemented on every refresh call.
3. Invalidate active tokens upon logout or password change via Redis blacklist.

Task Name: US-004: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Permission Matrix
Description: As an admin, I want granular permissions (Super Admin, Manager, Support Agent, Customer) so that access is restricted according to least privilege principle.

Task Name: US-005: Passwordless Magic Link Login Workflow
Description:
As a returning user, I want to receive a magic link via email to log in without entering a password.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Link expires in 10 minutes.
2. One-time use cryptographic hash verification.
3. Rate limit request to 3 attempts per hour per IP.
